faq_heading: 2 bedroom condos in Langley: your questions answered

faq.q: How much does a 2 bedroom condo cost in Langley?
faq.a: Of the 2 bedroom condos in Langley, 441 sold over the past year at a median of $540,000, with the middle half between $482,500 and $595,000.

faq.q: How long does a 2 bedroom condo take to sell in Langley?
faq.a: The median was 27 days, and homes sold for 97.2% of the list price at a median.

faq.q: Which Langley neighbourhood has the most 2 bedroom condos sales?
faq.a: Willoughby Heights, with 224 of the 441 sales at a median of $580,000.

faq.q: Which buildings in Langley have 2 bedroom condos for sale most often?
faq.a: By sales over the past year: Union Park (13 sales, median $595,000); Flora (13 sales, median $565,000); The Grove (12 sales, median $535,000); Latimer Village (10 sales, median $602,500).

faq.q: What is the strata fee on a 2 bedroom condo in Langley?
faq.a: The median strata fee on the 2 bedroom condos that sold in Langley was $433 a month. Fees vary by building, so check the building's own figure.

blocks.text: How 2 bedroom condos in Langley compare
A 2 bedroom condo in Langley sold for $120,000 more at the median than a 1 bedroom one ($540,000 against $420,000, 195 sales). The strata fee was $433 a month against $310.
A 2 bedroom condo in Langley sold for $138,500 less at the median than a 3 bedroom or larger one ($540,000 against $678,500, 71 sales). The strata fee was $433 a month against $483.
Of the 9 cities with 2 bedroom condo pages, Langley has the 5th highest median price. Chilliwack is lowest at $383,000 and Tsawwassen highest at $614,000.
